beeg-1.title: Elterngeld Eligibility, Working Hours Cap & Income Limit
beeg-1.summary: Establishes personal eligibility for Elterngeld, the 32-hour weekly working limit during allowance receipt, and the couple taxable-income eligibility cap (§ 1 Abs. 8 BEEG).
beeg-1.benefit: Protects parental allowance eligibility while working part-time up to 32 hours per week.
beeg-1.antiBenefit: Exceeding 32 weekly hours or surpassing the prior-year household taxable income cap (€175,000 from April 2025) eliminates entitlement completely.

estg-2.description: Prior-year taxable income eligibility uses § 2 Abs. 5 and Abs. 5a EStG.

beeg-4.description: Defines how eligible months are claimed across Basis and Plus budgets.

beeg-4b.description: Partnership bonus narrows the weekly hours corridor to 24–32 hours.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 1 BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Official eligibility criteria, 32h cap, and income threshold.

bmbfsfj_guidelines.label: BEEG Administrative Guidelines
bmbfsfj_guidelines.description: Federal ministry interpretation and rounding guidelines.

beeg-2.title: Amount of Elterngeld, Replacement Rate & Caps
beeg-2.summary: Defines the sliding replacement rate (65%–100%), the €2,770 assessable net ceiling, the €300 floor, and the €1,800 Basiselterngeld maximum.
beeg-2.benefit: Boosts replacement up to 100% for lower incomes below €1,000 and guarantees a €300 Basis floor.
beeg-2.antiBenefit: Caps assessable pre-birth net at €2,770 (max €1,800/month Basis) and reduces the rate from 67% down to 65% above €1,200.

beeg-2b.description: Assessment lookback selects the 12 eligible months feeding § 2.

beeg-2c.description: Standardized BEEG net from employment income is computed under § 2c.

beeg-4a.description: ElterngeldPlus caps payments at 50% of the no-income Basis amount.

beeg-2a.description: Sibling bonus adds 10% (min €75 Basis / €37.50 Plus) on top of § 2.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 2 BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Replacement scale, €300–€1,800 bounds, and €2,770 assessable net cap.

beeg-2a.title: Sibling Bonus (Geschwisterbonus) & Multiple-Birth Addition
beeg-2a.summary: Increases positive Elterngeld by 10% (at least €75/month Basis or €37.50/month Plus) when qualifying younger siblings live in the household.
beeg-2a.benefit: Adds +10% (min €75 Basis / €37.50 Plus) when 1 older child is under 3 or 2+ older children are under 6.
beeg-2a.antiBenefit: Applies only while the older sibling stays under the age threshold and adds nothing if the base allowance is zero.

beeg-2.description: Applies 10% uplift on top of the calculated § 2 entitlement.

beeg-4a.description: Halves the €75 minimum addition to €37.50 for ElterngeldPlus months.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 2a BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Sibling age routes (<36 months for 1 child, <72 months for 2+ children).

beeg-2b.title: Assessment Period & Statutory Exclusion Months
beeg-2b.summary: Selects the 12 eligible calendar months prior to birth or maternity protection and replaces statutory exclusion months (maternity, prior Elterngeld up to 14 life-months) with earlier months.
beeg-2b.benefit: Excludes maternity and earlier Elterngeld months so a closely spaced second birth can reach back to higher pre-birth earnings.
beeg-2b.antiBenefit: Denied prior Elterngeld claims or long unpaid gaps do not qualify as exclusion months and can dilute the 12-month average.

beeg-2c.description: Supplies the eligible months used to determine the frozen tax class.

muschg-3.description: Maternity protection months trigger statutory lookback exclusions.

beeg-2.description: Feeds the 12-month average into the § 2 replacement calculation.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 2b BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: 12-month assessment window and statutory exclusion rules.

beeg-2c.title: Employment Income & Tax-Class Tie-Breaking
beeg-2c.summary: Establishes how ongoing employment wages enter standardized Elterngeld net and selects the tax class that prevailed in the majority of eligible months (latest on a tie).
beeg-2c.benefit: A timely switch into a more favorable tax class (e.g. V→III) across the majority or tie-break of assessment months raises standardized net.
beeg-2c.antiBenefit: A late tax-class switch cannot rewrite the majority/tie rule, and higher monthly withholding reduces the other spouse's cash flow until annual reconciliation.

beeg-2b.description: Uses the eligible assessment months defined in § 2b BEEG.

beeg-2e.description: Standardized tax deductions are computed using the selected class under § 2e.

estg-38b.description: Wage tax classes I–VI originate from § 38b EStG.

estg-26b.description: Temporary class swaps do not change final annual liability under joint assessment.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 2c BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Deduction characteristic selection and employment income rules.

familienportal.label: Familienportal Tax-Class Guidance
familienportal.description: Official federal guidance on tax-class switches and equal-duration ties.

beeg-2d.title: Mixed & Self-Employed Income Rules
beeg-2d.summary: Coordinates assessment periods when self-employment or business income coincides with employment earnings.
beeg-2d.benefit: Prevents double counting and sets deterministic rules when non-employment income is present.
beeg-2d.antiBenefit: Self-employed or mixed income shifts the assessment period to the last concluded tax assessment year rather than 12 pre-birth months.

beeg-2b.description: Shifts the assessment window when profit-based income exists.

beeg-2c.description: Applies to non-employment profit income vs. § 2c employment wages.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 2d BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Assessment rules for profit and mixed income.

beeg-2e.title: Standardized BEEG Tax Deductions
beeg-2e.summary: Applies standardized income tax, solidarity surcharge, and flat church tax (8%) using the January PAP of the calendar year before birth.
beeg-2e.benefit: Creates a predictable standardized net separate from individual payroll quirks like mid-year allowances.
beeg-2e.antiBenefit: Ignores personal payroll allowances and depends on the January PAP snapshot from the year prior to birth.

bmf-pap.description: Uses the January BMF PAP table of the calendar year before birth.

beeg-2f.description: Combined with § 2f flat social deductions to form BEEG standardized net.

beeg-2c.description: Receives the frozen tax class and church tax flag from § 2c.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 2e BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Standardized BEEG tax deduction rules.

beeg-2f.title: Standardized BEEG Social Security Flat Deductions
beeg-2f.summary: Deducts flat statutory percentages (9% health/care, 10% pension, 2% unemployment) without ordinary contribution ceilings, plus a transition-zone factor.
beeg-2f.benefit: Applies a lower transition-zone deduction factor for low-to-mid incomes.
beeg-2f.antiBenefit: High earners have no upper contribution ceiling in BEEG net (unlike real payroll), reducing BEEG net compared to actual take-home pay.

beeg-2e.description: Combined with § 2e tax deductions to produce BEEG net.

sgb4-20.description: Transition-zone BEEG factor parallels the SGB IV Midijob corridor.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 2f BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Flat 9%/10%/2% social-insurance deductions for BEEG.

beeg-3.title: Offsetting Maternity & Wage-Replacement Benefits
beeg-3.summary: Credits maternity benefits (Mutterschaftsgeld and employer supplement) euro-for-euro against Elterngeld in overlapping months.
beeg-3.benefit: Ensures maternity pay covers 100% of prior net without consuming extra family Basis months beyond the offset.
beeg-3.antiBenefit: Maternity months still count as Basiselterngeld months used by the mother and zero out simultaneous Elterngeld payouts.

muschg-20.description: Offsets employer maternity supplement against Elterngeld.

beeg-4.description: Maternity offset months count toward the mother's Basis budget.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 3 BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Crediting rules for maternity and replacement benefits.

beeg-4.title: Claim Duration, Parent Budgets & Partner Months
beeg-4.summary: Allocates 12 Basis months plus 2 additional Partner months (14 total), subject to a minimum 2-month claim per claiming parent.
beeg-4.benefit: Grants 2 bonus Partner months when both parents claim at least 2 months each.
beeg-4.antiBenefit: Claims shorter than 2 life-months are forfeited, and parallel Basis months by both parents have statutory overlap limits.

beeg-4a.description: Each remaining Basis month can be converted into 2 ElterngeldPlus months.

beeg-4b.description: Adds up to 4 extra Plus months per parent via Partnership Bonus.

beeg-1.description: Requires meeting the § 1 weekly hours and income limits.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 4 BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: 12+2 family budget and 2-month minimum claim rules.

beeg-4a.title: ElterngeldPlus Calculation & Personal Ceiling
beeg-4a.summary: Doubles the payout duration at up to 50% of the no-income Basis entitlement (€150–€900/month), rewarding part-time post-birth work.
beeg-4a.benefit: Stretches budget months 2-for-1 and softens part-time income offsets compared to Basiselterngeld.
beeg-4a.antiBenefit: Strictly capped at half of the parent's no-income Basis entitlement (ceiling €900/month before sibling bonus).

beeg-2.description: Uses the parent's § 2 no-income Basis amount to set the 50% Plus cap.

beeg-4.description: Converts 1 Basis month into 2 ElterngeldPlus months.

beeg-4b.description: Partnership bonus months are paid under ElterngeldPlus rules.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 4a BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: ElterngeldPlus rate, cap, and conversion mechanics.

beeg-4b.title: Partnership Bonus (Partnerschaftsbonus)
beeg-4b.summary: Provides 2 to 4 additional ElterngeldPlus months for each parent if both simultaneously work 24–32 hours/week in consecutive months.
beeg-4b.benefit: Unlocks up to 4 extra ElterngeldPlus months per parent beyond the standard 14-month family budget.
beeg-4b.antiBenefit: If either parent breaks the 24–32h/week corridor in any consecutive bonus month, the bonus months can be reclaimed.

beeg-1.description: Tightens the § 1 max 32h limit into a 24–32h dual-parent corridor.

beeg-4a.description: Bonus months are computed and capped as ElterngeldPlus.

beeg-4.description: Adds supplementary months on top of the 12+2 family budget.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 4b BEEG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: 24–32h corridor and 2–4 consecutive month conditions.

estg-2.title: Income Categories & Taxable Income (zvE)
estg-2.summary: Defines total income, adjusted gross income, and taxable income (zu versteuerndes Einkommen), including § 2 Abs. 5a modifications for benefit eligibility.
estg-2.benefit: Provides the structured deduction chain from gross wages down to taxable income.
estg-2.antiBenefit: For Elterngeld income limits (§ 1 Abs. 8 BEEG), § 2 Abs. 5a adds back certain capital income and deductions.

estg-9a.description: Subtracts work-expense lump sum before arriving at employment income.

estg-32a.description: zvE from § 2 feeds the statutory § 32a income tax tariff.

beeg-1.description: Determines couple taxable income tested against the BEEG limit.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 2 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Scope of income and taxable income derivation.

estg-9-1-4.title: Commuter Distance Allowance (Entfernungspauschale) & Homeoffice Deduction
estg-9-1-4.summary: Deducts fixed per-kilometer work-commute allowances per office day (2024–2025: €0.30/km for first 20 km and €0.38/km from km 21; 2026+: €0.38/km from km 1; €4,500 non-car cap) plus up to €6/day (€1,260/yr) Homeoffice-Pauschale as income-related expenses.
estg-9-1-4.benefit: Lowers annual taxable income once total Werbungskosten exceed the €1,230 Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag, or via actual public-transit fares under § 9 Abs. 2 S. 2 EStG.
estg-9-1-4.antiBenefit: Does not yield additional tax savings until total Werbungskosten exceed the automatic €1,230 lump sum, and tax-free § 3 Nr. 15 JobTicket subsidies reduce distance claims euro for euro.

estg-9a.description: Only itemized work expenses exceeding the €1,230 lump sum produce extra tax relief.

estg-3-15.description: Tax-free employer transit subsidies reduce deductible commuter allowance under § 3 Nr. 15 S. 3 EStG.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 9 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Official Werbungskosten, Entfernungspauschale, and Homeoffice-Pauschale provisions.

estg-9a.title: Employee Work-Expense Lump Sum (Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag)
estg-9a.summary: Grants an automatic standard annual work-expense deduction (€1,230) against employment income without requiring receipts.
estg-9a.benefit: Automatically reduces taxable employment income by €1,230 per employed person per year.
estg-9a.antiBenefit: Already built into standard payroll tables, so it only generates an extra refund if actual itemized expenses exceed €1,230.

estg-19.description: Applies directly to employment income under § 19 EStG.

estg-2.description: Lowers net employment income entering § 2 EStG.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 9a EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Standard lump-sum work-expense deduction.

estg-10.title: Deductible Provident & Insurance Contributions (Vorsorgeaufwendungen)
estg-10.summary: Governs deductibility of statutory pension contributions, basic health/long-term care insurance, and other insurance caps.
estg-10.benefit: Allows full deduction of basic health/care contributions and statutory pension shares.
estg-10.antiBenefit: Other insurance premiums (like unemployment) are capped and crowded out once basic health/care exceeds €1,900 (€3,800 joint).

estg-10c.description: Works alongside the general special-expense lump sum.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 10 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Special-expense deductions for pension and health/care contributions.

estg-10-1-5.title: Childcare Expenses Special Deduction (Kinderbetreuungskosten)
estg-10-1-5.summary: Allows deducting qualified daycare, Kita, Tagesmutter, or nanny care expenses as Sonderausgaben for children under age 14: two-thirds up to €4,000/child through 2024, raised to 80% up to €4,800/child/year from 2025 under JStG 2024.
estg-10-1-5.benefit: Lowers annual joint taxable income (zvE) by up to €4,800 per child under 14 from 2025 onward (80% of €6,000 paid care expenses).
estg-10-1-5.antiBenefit: Covers pure care contributions only — meal charges and sports/music tuition remain non-deductible, and cash reimbursement requires verified invoices plus bank transfer.

estg-10.description: Itemized under § 10 EStG Sonderausgaben alongside provident insurance deductions.

estg-2.description: Reduces annual joint taxable income (§ 2 Abs. 4 EStG).

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 10 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Deductibility of childcare expenses as Sonderausgaben.

bundesgesetzblatt.label: Jahressteuergesetz 2024 (BGBl. I 2024 Nr. 387)
bundesgesetzblatt.description: Raised deductible share from 2/3 (€4,000) to 80% (€4,800) starting 2025.

estg-10c.title: Special-Expense Lump Sum (Sonderausgaben-Pauschbetrag)
estg-10c.summary: Provides a small automatic special-expense allowance (€36 single / €72 joint) when no higher itemized special expenses are claimed.
estg-10c.benefit: Automatically reduces taxable income by €36 (€72 joint) without documentation.
estg-10c.antiBenefit: Modest fixed amount that does not scale with income.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 10c EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Standard €36 / €72 special-expense lump sum.

estg-19.title: Income from Employment (Einkünfte aus nichtselbständiger Arbeit)
estg-19.summary: Classifies regular wages, salaries, bonuses, and employer supplements as taxable employment income.
estg-19.benefit: Qualifies for the § 9a work-expense lump sum and standard payroll withholding.
estg-19.antiBenefit: Contractual bonuses and 13th-month salaries are taxed as ordinary employment income.

estg-9a.description: Reduced by the § 9a EStG employee expense allowance.

estg-39b.description: Regular vs. one-off bonus withholding rules under § 39b apply.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 19 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Definition of taxable employment wages and extras.

estg-20.title: Capital Investment Income (Kapitalerträge)
estg-20.summary: Governs dividends, interest, and investment gains; excluded from BEEG employment earnings but relevant for § 2 Abs. 5a eligibility.
estg-20.benefit: Allows tracking passive dividend/ETF cash flows separately from employment payroll.
estg-20.antiBenefit: Still counts toward the prior-year household taxable income cap for Elterngeld eligibility.

estg-2.description: Enters § 2 Abs. 5a EStG modifications for benefit income limits.

beeg-1.description: Can push household income above the BEEG § 1 Abs. 8 limit.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 20 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Taxation of dividends, interest, and capital gains.

estg-24a.title: Age Relief Allowance (Altersentlastungsbetrag)
estg-24a.summary: Grants an age-cohort percentage relief (with an annual euro cap) on positive wages for taxpayers over age 64 on January 1.
estg-24a.benefit: Reduces annual taxable income automatically based on the permanent birth-year cohort.
estg-24a.antiBenefit: Cohort percentage and euro cap phase down over time and require known age at start of year.

estg-2.description: Deducted when computing annual adjusted gross income.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 24a EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Age relief cohort table and maximum annual amounts.

estg-24b.title: Single-Parent Tax Relief (Entlastungsbetrag für Alleinerziehende)
estg-24b.summary: Grants €4,260 relief (plus €240 per additional qualifying child) to eligible single parents in Tax Class II.
estg-24b.benefit: Significantly lowers Tax Class II withholding and annual taxable income for qualifying single parents.
estg-24b.antiBenefit: Lost immediately if another adult shares the household registration (no true single-parent household).

estg-38b.description: Incorporated into Tax Class II wage withholding.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 24b EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Single-parent relief base and extra-child increments.

estg-26.title: Election of Individual vs. Joint Assessment
estg-26.summary: Allows married spouses or registered civil partners to elect either individual assessment or joint assessment.
estg-26.benefit: Gives couples flexibility to choose joint splitting or separate assessment when beneficial.
estg-26.antiBenefit: Joint assessment is never automatic from living together; it requires marriage/registered partnership and explicit election.

estg-26b.description: Joint assessment election triggers the § 26b splitting calculation.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 26 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Conditions for spouse/partner assessment election.

estg-26b.title: Joint Spousal Assessment (Zusammenveranlagung)
estg-26b.summary: Pools both spouses' taxable income and reconciles withheld payroll taxes against the joint splitting tariff.
estg-26b.benefit: Equalizes asymmetric earnings (e.g. during parental leave) and often generates refunds when one partner stops working.
estg-26b.antiBenefit: A III/V or IV-factor setup can still trigger a tax repayment at year-end when combined with § 32b progression income.

estg-26.description: Requires an eligible joint-assessment election under § 26.

estg-32a.description: Applies the § 32a Abs. 5 splitting formula to pooled zvE.

estg-32b.description: Elterngeld/Mutterschutz progression raises the effective tax rate on joint income.

estg-36.description: Reconciles assessed liability against monthly withheld tax credits.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 26b EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Pooling of spousal income under joint assessment.

estg-31.title: Family Equalization & Günstigerprüfung
estg-31.summary: Automatically compares Kindergeld received during the year against the tax savings from the Kinderfreibetrag and grants whichever is higher.
estg-31.benefit: High-marginal-rate households automatically receive the extra tax relief above paid Kindergeld.
estg-31.antiBenefit: Middle- and lower-income households receive no extra tax deduction because Kindergeld already exceeds the tax relief.

estg-32.description: Tests the annual § 32 Abs. 6 Kinderfreibetrag amount.

estg-66.description: Compares tax relief against monthly § 66 Kindergeld payouts.

solzg-3.description: Kinderfreibetrag always reduces the Solidarity Surcharge base even when Kindergeld wins.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 31 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Mandatory tax-office Günstigerprüfung rule.

estg-32.title: Child Allowance (Kinderfreibetrag & BEA)
estg-32.summary: Sets the annual tax-free allowance per child (subsistence + care/education/training allowance), prorated by birth month.
estg-32.benefit: Protects the minimum subsistence cost of each child from income tax and reduces SolZ/church tax.
estg-32.antiBenefit: Only lowers income tax if its tax relief exceeds annual Kindergeld under § 31 Günstigerprüfung.

estg-66.description: Alternative to monthly Kindergeld cash payments.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 32 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Child definition and Kinderfreibetrag amounts.

estg-32a.title: Income Tax Tariff & Splitting Formula
estg-32a.summary: Defines the piecewise progressive German income tax formula (basic allowance, two quadratic zones, 42% top zone, 45% highest zone) and the Abs. 5 splitting tariff.
estg-32a.benefit: Exempts income up to the Grundfreibetrag and halves progression for joint spouses via the splitting factor 2 × T(zvE / 2).
estg-32a.antiBenefit: Steep marginal progression in Zones 2–3 means extra income or progression benefits increase effective tax rates quickly.

estg-26b.description: Applies Abs. 5 splitting formula for joint assessment.

estg-32b.description: Progression clause modifies the average rate applied to § 32a.

estg-2.description: Takes annual zvE from § 2 EStG as input.

gesetze_im_internet.description: Piecewise progressive tariff coefficients and splitting formula.

estg-32b.title: Progression Clause (Progressionsvorbehalt)
estg-32b.summary: Adds tax-free wage-replacement benefits (Elterngeld, Mutterschaftsgeld) to taxable income solely to determine a higher average tax rate on remaining taxable income.
estg-32b.benefit: Elterngeld and Mutterschutz stay tax-free themselves — only the rate on other taxable income is adjusted.
estg-32b.antiBenefit: Frequently triggers unexpected year-end tax repayments when one spouse continues earning high salary while the other receives Elterngeld.

estg-32a.description: Computes effective average rate at T(zvE + benefits) / (zvE + benefits).

estg-26b.description: Hits joint spousal income during parental-leave years.

beeg-2.description: Elterngeld payouts enter the § 32b progression base.

estg-36.title: Annual Tax Credits & Signed Settlement
estg-36.summary: Credits withheld monthly wage tax and solidarity surcharge against final assessed annual tax liability, yielding a refund or repayment.
estg-36.benefit: Returns excess monthly withholding (e.g. from temporary Class V during § 2b optimization) after filing.
estg-36.antiBenefit: Produces a tax repayment bill when monthly withholding (e.g. Class III or § 32b years) was lower than final liability.

estg-38b.description: Reconciles monthly payroll withholding back to true liability.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 36 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Assessment settlement and credit rules.

estg-38b.title: Wage Tax Classes (Lohnsteuerklassen I–VI)
estg-38b.summary: Assigns monthly payroll tax classes: I (single), II (single parent), III/V (spousal split), IV/IV (equal split), VI (secondary job).
estg-38b.benefit: Lets couples shape monthly net cash flow and legally optimize Elterngeld assessment under § 2c BEEG.
estg-38b.antiBenefit: Does not reduce total annual income tax; Class III/V or V/III only shifts timing between monthly payroll and § 36 settlement.

estg-39f.description: Class IV + Factor spreads joint tax liability proportionally.

beeg-2c.description: Payroll tax class determines BEEG standardized tax deductions.

estg-36.description: Monthly differences are settled at year-end under § 36.

gesetze_im_internet.description: Classification rules for wage tax classes I–VI.

estg-39b.title: Monthly Payroll & One-Off Bonus Withholding (Sonstige Bezüge)
estg-39b.summary: Governs regular monthly wage-tax withholding and the differential annualization method for irregular bonuses (13th-month / vacation / Christmas bonuses).
estg-39b.benefit: Prevents over-withholding on regular monthly paychecks when bonuses occur.
estg-39b.antiBenefit: Bonuses face differential annual marginal withholding and do not count as ongoing regular pay for BEEG Elterngeld.

estg-39f.title: Class IV Factor Method (Faktorverfahren)
estg-39f.summary: Applies a 3-decimal-truncated splitting factor to Class IV withholding so spouses pay near-exact proportional annual tax every month.
estg-39f.benefit: Avoids large year-end tax repayments common with III/V while reflecting splitting gains immediately.
estg-39f.antiBenefit: Reduces the higher-earning or leave-planning spouse's BEEG net compared to strategically switching into Class III.

estg-38b.description: Modifies Tax Class IV monthly payroll withholding.

bmf-pap.description: Factor calculation uses the published BMF PAP tax tables.

gesetze_im_internet.description: Formula and 3-decimal truncation for Class IV factor.

estg-62.title: Kindergeld Personal Entitlement Conditions
estg-62.summary: Establishes residency, parental relationship, and personal eligibility criteria for monthly Kindergeld.
estg-62.benefit: Covers biological, adopted, and qualifying household children in Germany.
estg-62.antiBenefit: Requires valid German residency/tax-status ties and ongoing child qualification.

estg-66.description: Determines who receives the monthly § 66 payout.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 62 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Residency and personal eligibility for Kindergeld.

estg-66.title: Monthly Child Benefit Amount (Kindergeld)
estg-66.summary: Sets the uniform monthly tax-exempt child benefit payment per qualifying child (€259/month in 2026).
estg-66.benefit: Provides steady, tax-free monthly cash per child regardless of parent income.
estg-66.antiBenefit: Credited against the § 32 Kinderfreibetrag tax advantage during annual § 31 Günstigerprüfung.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 66 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Monthly Kindergeld euro amount per child.

inflg.title: Bracket Creep Relief & Inflation Adjustment (Inflationsausgleich)
inflg.summary: Periodically shifts § 32a EStG tariff brackets, Grundfreibetrag, and Kinderfreibetrag upward to neutralize cold progression and model future statutory inflation indexing.
inflg.benefit: Prevents inflation-driven nominal wage increases from pushing households into higher real income tax brackets.
inflg.antiBenefit: Unlegislated future years beyond verified statutory tables (2026+) depend on optional projection assumptions rather than fixed law.

estg-32a.description: Adjusts § 32a EStG Grundfreibetrag and zone ceilings for inflation.

estg-32.description: Accompanies periodic adjustments to the § 32 Kinderfreibetrag.

bundesgesetzblatt.label: Steuerfortentwicklungsgesetz (BGBl. I 2024 Nr. 449)
bundesgesetzblatt.description: Statutory inflation-compensation adjustments for 2025 and 2026 tariffs.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 32a EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Underlying progressive income tax tariff structure.

muschg-3.title: Maternity Protection Windows (Mutterschutzfristen)
muschg-3.summary: Prohibits employment during the statutory protection window (6 weeks before expected birth and 8 weeks after birth, 12 weeks for premature/multiple births).
muschg-3.benefit: Protects health and triggers full net wage replacement alongside § 2b BEEG exclusion protection.
muschg-3.antiBenefit: Calendar-month simulations approximate day-exact 6/8-week windows; premature or multiple births extend post-birth windows.

muschg-19.description: Triggers statutory Mutterschaftsgeld payouts during the protection window.

muschg-20.description: Triggers the employer supplement topping up to 100% of prior net.

beeg-2b.description: Maternity protection months are excluded from later BEEG lookbacks.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 3 MuSchG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Pre-birth and post-birth employment protection periods.

muschg-19.title: Statutory Maternity Allowance (Mutterschaftsgeld)
muschg-19.summary: Provides the health-insurer share of maternity pay (up to €13/calendar day for statutory insured employees) during § 3 protection periods.
muschg-19.benefit: Tax-free base maternity contribution paired with the employer supplement.
muschg-19.antiBenefit: Offsets Elterngeld under § 3 BEEG and enters § 32b EStG progression.

muschg-20.description: Combined with employer supplement to reach 100% of average net.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 19 MuSchG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Statutory maternity allowance calculation.

muschg-20.title: Employer Maternity Supplement (Arbeitgeberzuschuss)
muschg-20.summary: Requires employers to top up § 19 Mutterschaftsgeld to 100% of the average net wage of the last 3 completed calendar months before protection starts.
muschg-20.benefit: Maintains 100% of pre-maternity net pay during the protection window without payroll tax withholding.
muschg-20.antiBenefit: Because it uses the last 3 months before maternity, a late pay cut lowers it, and it still counts toward § 32b progression.

muschg-19.description: Tops up § 19 health-insurer payments to 100% net.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 20 MuSchG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: 3-month reference earnings for employer maternity supplement.

solzg-1.title: Solidarity Surcharge Levy Scope
solzg-1.summary: Establishes the Solidarity Surcharge (Solidaritätszuschlag) levied on assessed and withheld income tax.
solzg-1.benefit: Most middle-income earners are fully exempt thanks to § 3/§ 4 SolzG exemption thresholds.
solzg-1.antiBenefit: Applies on top of income tax for high earners and in the mitigation phase-in zone.

solzg-3.description: Base calculation reduces tax base by Kinderfreibetrag under § 3.

solzg-4.description: Rate and mitigation zone are defined in § 4 SolzG.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 1 SolzG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Scope of the Solidarity Surcharge.

solzg-3.title: Solidarity Surcharge Assessment Base & Child Relief
solzg-3.summary: Computes the Solidarity Surcharge tax base after always deducting child allowances (§ 32 Abs. 6 EStG) regardless of Kindergeld favorability.
solzg-3.benefit: Parents always get the Kinderfreibetrag reduction on Solidarity Surcharge even when Kindergeld beats income tax.
solzg-3.antiBenefit: Increases complexity because SolZ uses a separate notional tax base from income tax when Kindergeld wins.

estg-32.description: Always deducts Kinderfreibetrag when computing SolZ base.

solzg-4.description: Passes reduced tax base to § 4 SolzG rate and exemption.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 3 SolzG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Notional child-adjusted SolZ assessment base.

solzg-4.title: Solidarity Surcharge Rate, Exemption & Mitigation Zone
solzg-4.summary: Applies 5.5% surcharge above the exemption threshold (doubled for joint spouses), phased in smoothly via the 11.9% mitigation zone.
solzg-4.benefit: Exempts income tax below €19,950 (single) / €39,900 (joint) in 2025, rising in 2026.
solzg-4.antiBenefit: The 11.9% phase-in mitigation zone temporarily creates a higher effective marginal tax rate.

solzg-3.description: Uses the § 3 assessment base and exemption thresholds.

estg-32a.description: Surcharge scales off assessed § 32a income tax.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 4 SolzG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: 5.5% rate, 11.9% mitigation cap, and exemption bounds.

sgb3-341.title: Statutory Unemployment Insurance Contribution Rate
sgb3-341.summary: Sets the total statutory unemployment insurance contribution rate (2.6%, split equally 1.3% employee / 1.3% employer) up to the pension assessment ceiling.
sgb3-341.benefit: Funds unemployment protection and is capped at the annual pension contribution ceiling.
sgb3-341.antiBenefit: Employee share may be crowded out of § 10 EStG tax deductibility once health/care premiums exceed the other-insurance limit.

sgb6-158.description: Shares the statutory pension assessment ceiling.

sgb4-20.description: Midijob transition zone reduces employee contributions under § 20 SGB IV.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 341 SGB III Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Official unemployment contribution rate.

sgb4-20.title: Midijob Transition Zone (Übergangsbereich)
sgb4-20.summary: Reduces employee social-security contributions smoothly for monthly regular wages between the Minijob threshold and €2,000 while preserving full pension entitlements.
sgb4-20.benefit: Significantly increases net take-home pay for mid-low and part-time salaries without losing pension credits.
sgb4-20.antiBenefit: Does not cover special trainee/student or multiple-job scenarios automatically and interacts specially with care surcharges.

sgb5-241.description: Uses reduced employee contribution base in the Midijob corridor.

sgb11-55.description: Care childless surcharge uses the total transition base while child discounts use employee base.

beeg-2f.description: Paralleled by BEEG's own transition factor under § 2f.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 20 SGB IV Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Midijob corridor formula and F-factor definition.

sgb4-23a.title: One-Off Bonus Contributions & March Clause
sgb4-23a.summary: Uses year-to-date social-security assessment ceilings to determine how much of a bonus (e.g. vacation or Christmas bonus) is subject to social contributions.
sgb4-23a.benefit: Above annual contribution ceilings, extra bonus payments avoid further health, pension, and unemployment deductions.
sgb4-23a.antiBenefit: Bonuses paid between January and March can be attributed to the prior calendar year (Märzklausel) if YTD limits are exceeded.

estg-39b.description: Coordinates social contribution caps with Sonstige Bezüge wage tax.

bvv-2.description: Applies statutory cent-rounding to one-off contribution bases.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 23a SGB IV Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Annual YTD contribution assessment for one-off payments.

sgb5-241.title: Statutory Health Insurance Rate (GKV)
sgb5-241.summary: Sets the general statutory health contribution rate (14.6%, shared 7.3% employee / 7.3% employer) plus the insurer-specific Zusatzbeitrag (also shared 50/50).
sgb5-241.benefit: Covers family members including children at no extra premium and is fully tax-deductible for basic coverage.
sgb5-241.antiBenefit: Insurer Zusatzbeitrag varies by provider and increases deductions proportionally up to the annual health ceiling.

bvv-2.description: General rate and Zusatzbeitrag are rounded separately before addition.

estg-10.description: Basic health share (96% of general contribution) is tax-deductible.

sgb4-20.description: Reduced inside the Midijob transition zone.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 241 SGB V Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: General 14.6% statutory health contribution rate.

sgb6-158.title: Statutory Pension Insurance Rate (RV)
sgb6-158.summary: Sets the statutory pension contribution rate (18.6%, shared 9.3% employee / 9.3% employer) up to the statutory pension ceiling.
sgb6-158.benefit: Builds statutory retirement entitlements and is 100% tax-deductible under § 10 EStG.
sgb6-158.antiBenefit: Represents the largest single social deduction on gross pay up to the pension assessment ceiling.

estg-10.description: Employee pension contributions are 100% deductible under § 10 EStG.

sgb3-341.description: Shares the statutory annual pension ceiling.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 158 SGB VI Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Statutory pension contribution rate.

sgb11-55.title: Care Insurance Child Surcharge & Child Discounts
sgb11-55.summary: Adds a +0.6% surcharge for childless employees aged 23+ and grants -0.25% per qualifying child (children 2 through 5 under age 25).
sgb11-55.benefit: Parents with 2–5 children under 25 save up to 1.0 percentage point on long-term care contributions.
sgb11-55.antiBenefit: Childless employees aged 23+ pay an unshared +0.6% surcharge, and discounts expire as children turn 25.

sgb11-58.description: Coordinates base employee/employer care share (including Saxony rule).

sgb4-20.description: Midijob transition applies distinct bases to surcharge vs. child discounts.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 55 SGB XI Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Childless surcharge and under-25 multi-child discount rules.

sgb11-58.title: Long-Term Care Employer/Employee Split & Saxony Rule
sgb11-58.summary: Splits the standard care insurance rate equally between employer and employee outside Saxony, while Saxony shifts an extra 0.5% to employees.
sgb11-58.benefit: Equal 50/50 base rate sharing across 15 German federal states.
sgb11-58.antiBenefit: Employees working in Saxony pay an additional 0.5% employee care contribution.

sgb11-55.description: Combined with childless surcharge or child discounts under § 55.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 58 SGB XI Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Employee/employer split and Saxony adjustment.

bvv-2.title: Social Contribution Rounding Rules
bvv-2.summary: Requires calculating and rounding general health contributions and the insurer Zusatzbeitrag separately to cents before summing.
bvv-2.benefit: Ensures payroll cent parity with certified German payroll engines.
bvv-2.antiBenefit: Tiny 1-cent rounding differences can occur if rates are summed before multiplying the base.

sgb5-241.description: Governs cent rounding for § 241 SGB V health contributions.

sgb4-23a.description: Applies to one-off bonus social contribution bases.

kfw-300.title: KfW 300 Home Ownership for Families (Wohneigentum für Familien)
kfw-300.summary: KfW 300 offers a subsidized loan to eligible families for a self-occupied, climate-friendly new build or qualifying first purchase in Germany. Income, household, ownership and technical conditions apply.
kfw-300.benefit: Provides subsidized housing loans for energy-efficient homes when zvE stays below the family threshold.
kfw-300.antiBenefit: KfW checks additional conditions that this calculator does not verify. Income is based on the applicable tax assessments; the building must meet technical requirements confirmed by experts.

estg-2.description: Tests household taxable income (zvE) from official tax assessments.

grestg-11.description: Combines with regional real estate transfer tax during family home acquisition.

kfw_portal.label: KfW 300 official program details
kfw_portal.description: Official eligibility, building requirements, and loan terms.

estg-3-15.title: Tax-Free Employer JobTicket & Public Transit Subsidies
estg-3-15.summary: Exempts employer-paid public transit and Deutschlandticket subsidies provided in addition to contractual salary from income tax and social security, while offsetting the commuter distance allowance.
estg-3-15.benefit: Delivers 100% tax-free and social-contribution-free commuting support when paid on top of agreed salary.
estg-3-15.antiBenefit: Reduces the employee's claimable § 9 Abs. 1 Nr. 4 Entfernungspauschale euro-for-euro by the tax-free subsidy amount.

estg-9-1-4.description: Credited against claimable commuter Entfernungspauschale (§ 3 Nr. 15 S. 3 EStG).

estg-9a.description: Offsetting commuter deductions can still leave full €1,230 Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag intact.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 3 Nr. 15 EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Tax exemption conditions and Werbungskosten offset rule for employer JobTickets.

estg-3-72.title: Residential Photovoltaic Income Tax Exemption
estg-3-72.summary: Exempts income and self-consumption withdrawals from small photovoltaic installations (up to 30 kWp on single-family homes) from German income tax.
estg-3-72.benefit: Eliminates income-tax reporting and EÜR profit taxation on qualifying rooftop solar earnings.
estg-3-72.antiBenefit: Does not shield installations exceeding statutory kWp ceilings per residential unit.

ustg-12-3.description: Pairs with 0% VAT on system purchase for tax-free rooftop solar operation.

eeg-48.description: Applies to feed-in remuneration collected under § 48 EEG.

gesetze_im_internet.description: Official statutory text governing income tax exemptions for small PV plants.

estg-6-1-4.title: Company Car Private Use & Electric Vehicle Basis Reduction
estg-6-1-4.summary: Sets monthly taxable private-use valuation at 1% of gross list price (0.5% PHEV; 0.25% pure EV up to the statutory price cap).
estg-6-1-4.benefit: Pure electric company cars up to €100,000 gross list price pay tax on only one-quarter of the list price.
estg-6-1-4.antiBenefit: Vehicles above the €100,000 BEV cap drop from 0.25% to 0.5%; ICE vehicles carry the full 1.0% taxable uplift.

estg-8-2.description: Combined with the 0.03%/km commute surcharge on the reduced assessment basis.

estg-19.description: Adds imputed benefit-in-kind to monthly taxable employment wages.

gesetze_im_internet.description: Official valuation rules for company car private usage.

estg-8-2.title: Company Car Commute Valuation (0.03% / 0.002%)
estg-8-2.summary: Values regular home-to-work commutes with a company car at 0.03% of effective list price per one-way km monthly (or 0.002% per actual office trip).
estg-8-2.benefit: Employees frequently working remotely can switch to 0.002% actual-trip valuation if commuting under ~15 days/month.
estg-8-2.antiBenefit: Long one-way commutes compound monthly taxable benefit rapidly under the standard 0.03% flat rule.

estg-6-1-4.description: Applies 0.03% or 0.002% to the quartered/halved EV/PHEV or full ICE list-price basis.

gesetze_im_internet.description: Official valuation rules for commuting benefits in kind.

estg-35a.title: Household Services & Craftsmanship Tax Credit
estg-35a.summary: Credits 20% of qualifying craftsman labor invoices directly against annual income tax liability, capped at €1,200/year (€6,000 labor).
estg-35a.benefit: Direct euro-for-euro income tax reduction up to €1,200/year for home renovation and maintenance labor.
estg-35a.antiBenefit: Material costs and cash payments are excluded; requires bank-transfer invoice verification.

kfw-300.description: Applies to direct unsubsidized renovation labor not funded by public grant programs.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 35a EStG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Official tax credit limits for household craftsmanship services.

aufenthg-18-2-5.title: Age 45+ Skilled Worker Pension-Adequacy Salary Floor
aufenthg-18-2-5.summary: Applicants receiving their first skilled work residence permit at age 45 or older must earn at least 55% of the statutory pension ceiling or prove adequate retirement provision.
aufenthg-18-2-5.benefit: Protects older incoming professionals from old-age poverty risk through an objective salary or pension-proof gate.
aufenthg-18-2-5.antiBenefit: First-time applicants aged 45+ below €55,770 gross/yr (2026) must document separate private pension assets.

aufenthg-18g.description: EU Blue Card carries its own salary gate; non-Blue-Card skilled permits apply the 45+ threshold.

sgb6-158.description: 55% threshold derives directly from the annual general pension BBG ceiling.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 18 AufenthG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Official skilled immigration conditions and 45+ pension adequacy rule.

aufenthg-18c.title: Fast-Track Permanent Settlement (Niederlassungserlaubnis)
aufenthg-18c.summary: EU Blue Card holders qualify for permanent settlement after 27 months with basic A1 German, or after 21 months with B1 German proficiency.
aufenthg-18c.benefit: Shortens permanent residency wait from 60 months to 21 months (B1 German) or 27 months (A1 German).
aufenthg-18c.antiBenefit: Requires uninterrupted qualified employment and compulsory statutory pension contributions throughout the period.

aufenthg-18g.description: Blue Card duration directly accelerates § 18c settlement eligibility.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 18c AufenthG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Official permanent residence timelines for skilled workers and Blue Card holders.

aufenthg-18g.title: EU Blue Card (Blaue Karte EU)
aufenthg-18g.summary: Primary German work permit for university graduates earning at least 50% of BBG RV (2026: €50,700) or 45.3% for shortage/recent graduates/IT (€45,934.20).
aufenthg-18g.benefit: Unlocks spouse work authorization without German tests and accelerated permanent residency under § 18c AufenthG.
aufenthg-18g.antiBenefit: Annual salary adjustments are reassessed at renewal against updated BBG-indexed thresholds.

aufenthg-18c.description: Qualifies holder for 21/27-month permanent residence track.

aufenthg-20a.description: Applies when an eligible job offer exists; otherwise Opportunity Card enables job-search entry.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 18g AufenthG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Official German EU Blue Card eligibility and salary rules.

make_it_in_germany.label: Make it in Germany — EU Blue Card
make_it_in_germany.description: Official federal portal confirming current Blue Card salary thresholds.

aufenthg-20a.title: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Points System
aufenthg-20a.summary: Permits 1-year job-seeking entry in Germany via recognized degree OR 6 statutory points covering qualifications, experience, German/English level, and age, plus €1,091/mo living funds.
aufenthg-20a.benefit: Allows international specialists without a pre-signed job contract to search on-site and work up to 20h/week part-time.
aufenthg-20a.antiBenefit: Requires proof of secured monthly livelihood (typically blocked account or declaration of commitment).

aufenthg-18g.description: Holders transition directly to EU Blue Card once a qualifying job contract is signed.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 20a AufenthG Statutory Text
gesetze_im_internet.description: Official statutory text for Opportunity Card scoring and subsistence.

ustg-12-3.title: 0% VAT Rate on Residential Solar PV & Storage
ustg-12-3.summary: Reduces German value-added tax from 19% to 0% for delivery and installation of residential solar panels, inverters, and home batteries.
ustg-12-3.benefit: Saves 19/119 (~15.97%) off standard gross hardware and installation invoices immediately at purchase.
ustg-12-3.antiBenefit: Applies strictly to systems installed on or near residential/public buildings; commercial-only sites remain at 19%.

estg-3-72.description: Pairs zero acquisition VAT with zero ongoing income tax on residential PV.

gesetze_im_internet.label: § 12 UStG Tax Rates
gesetze_im_internet.description: Official VAT zero-rating rules for residential photovoltaic installations.

eeg-48.title: Statutory 20-Year Solar Feed-In Tariff (Einspeisevergütung)
eeg-48.summary: Guarantees fixed ct/kWh feed-in tariffs for surplus (Teileinspeisung) or full export (Volleinspeisung) over 20 calendar years, tiered at <= 10 kWp and 10–40 kWp.
eeg-48.benefit: Guarantees stable 20-year grid export revenues alongside ~37 ct/kWh avoided retail grid purchases.
eeg-48.antiBenefit: Semi-annual 1% tariff degression reduces rates slightly for later commissioning dates.

estg-3-72.description: Feed-in payments under § 48 EEG remain income-tax exempt up to 30 kWp.

bundesnetzagentur.label: Bundesnetzagentur EEG Tariffs
bundesnetzagentur.description: Official semi-annual PV feed-in tariff schedule.

grestg-11.title: Real Estate Transfer Tax (Grunderwerbsteuer)
grestg-11.summary: Applies state-specific real estate transfer tax (3.5% in Bavaria to 6.5% in NRW, Brandenburg, Saarland, Schleswig-Holstein) on residential property purchases.
grestg-11.benefit: Exemptions apply to close direct-line family transfers (§ 3 Nr. 4/6 GrEStG).
grestg-11.antiBenefit: Closing taxes plus notary/registry and agent fees cannot typically be financed with equity-free mortgages.

kfw-300.description: Upfront closing taxes remain required alongside KfW 300 subsidized financing.

gesetze_im_internet.description: Official tax rate framework for German Real Estate Transfer Tax.

bmf-pap.title: Federal Ministry of Finance Payroll Tax Algorithm (PAP)
bmf-pap.summary: Official annual flowchart algorithm published by BMF governing monthly wage tax and solidarity withholding across Germany.
bmf-pap.benefit: Guarantees exact statutory payroll withholding parity with official BMF tax tables.
bmf-pap.antiBenefit: Only verified published years exist; BEEG standardized net specifically requires the January snapshot of the year prior to birth.

estg-39b.description: Executes statutory § 39b EStG monthly and bonus withholding.

beeg-2e.description: January PAP snapshot before birth determines BEEG § 2e tax deductions.
